lean.note: `divinN_of_hypV` extracts summability and the stronger bound from `vvRecord`, then uses $\sqrt b\le b$ before calling `divinN_at`. The proof extracts the cohomological bound and passes it to divinN_at after weakening the square-root bound to b.
